milestone: Native CPU arrays of finite immutable records with retained nested collection fields

implementation.types: Homogeneous nominal [Record] arrays with finite nested records, numeric/Bool leaves and numeric array/tensor fields
implementation.operations: Literal/contextual empty construction, checked indexing, length, branches, helper/module returns, record-array captures in numeric callbacks, CPU workers and recovery
implementation.layout: Contiguous LLVM record cells with canonical array descriptors; source allocation/indexing and task transport share the pinned macOS ARM64 target layout
implementation.ownership: Invocation-owned array backing, inline immutable element copies and recursive worker retention of each element numeric collection backing
implementation.validation: Parent count/byte/alignment/source-owner validation before traversal, then nested descriptor/static-shape validation before publication
implementation.cancellation: Retention loop polls destination cancellation every 256 elements; failed retention leaves output untouched and partial owners settle
implementation.literal_budget: Default 300000 expanded scalar/descriptor storage units across literal elements, including repeated aliases

coverage: Six numeric families including raw NaNs, signed zeros, integer limits and random values
Scalar-only integer/Bool layouts, Boolean-only cells and target tail padding
Nested array/tensor fields sharing allocation backing across fields
Empty and nonempty arrays, branches, imported helper results and task arguments/results
Borrowed packet overwrite, source invocation settlement, cached observations and scheduler destruction
Parent/nested descriptor and fixed-field shape rejection before publication
Cancelled retention loop and failed observations leave output buffers untouched
Pre-dispatch cancellation/deadlines, admission rejection, task and invocation allocation failure
Four integer index types, bounds failures, immutable indexed updates, numeric callback capture
TaskError fallback arrays, written element evaluation order and failed-build artifact preservation
Executable documentation and previous arrays/records/callbacks/modules/compiler/ownership/task/selected GPU regressions
qualification.scope: Focused qualification, not the full registered suite

boundaries: Record arrays inside record fields and recursive managed records remain pending
Nested arrays, record tensors and record-array CLI display remain pending
Storage sharing and earlier reclamation remain optimization work
C/C++ integration and native distributed execution use separate roadmaps
parser_followup: FRONT-001: a leading array-literal statement immediately after a block-valued binding can produce P010; documented in docs/design/frontend.md, unchanged in this milestone
